text: Use well-spaced, intricate flowing lightening patterns with a spiritual aesthetic. Pointed or arrow-like forms and curved quarter-circle edges may suit the part. Keep printable webs, strong loaded joints and hardware clearance.

In top view, make the key holder upper-edge taper more symmetrical between both sides despite the battery on one side, preserving compactness, useful hardware clearance and strong functional roots without adding redundant bulk.
